card.name: Words just before sensory neuropathy type
card.fires_on: Small linking or qualifying words right before a description of the type of peripheral neuropathy, such as sensory, sensorimotor or axonal. It appears in warnings about nerve damage.

modes.label: Qualifier before sensory
modes.description: Adverbs or commas such as mainly or predominantly that come just before the word sensory.
modes.example: Peripheral neuropathy,<< mainly>> of sensory type has been reported and is

modes.label: Linking word before neuropathy type
modes.description: Words like as, with, an or of that lead into sensorimotor or axonal polyneuropathy.
modes.example: The neuropathy was most often characterized<< as>> sensory or sensorimotor.
